Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the run-through on the call earlier. Per our discussion, I've attached the completed W-9 and a bank verification letter to support our ACH setup. Please confirm what else you need to move the PO forward. Attachments: GI_W9_signed.pdf (W-9), GI_bank_letter.pdf (bank verification)

Would love to get the PO live this week if possible — our onboarding team is standing by.

Hi Nadia — thanks for sending these so quickly and for the call this morning. I pulled the documents into our onboarding queue and did a quick check against the IRS EIN registry. Two items for us to confirm before we release the PO:

1) Name mismatch: the W-9 lists "Global Integrations Ltd." while the IRS lookup shows the EIN tied to "Global Integrations LLC". Can you confirm which legal name should appear on the W-9 (and on Redwood's PO)?

2) Proof of EIN: could you provide a short screenshot of the IRS EIN confirmation page or a signed corporate letter on letterhead that shows the EIN and legal name? That will clear the tax identity step for our payments team.

I'm looping in Soojin (tax/compliance) and Marcus (procurement) so they can weigh in on whether a conditional/partial PO is possible while you update the W-9.

If it's easier, you can reply with the screenshot attached to this thread — that'll speed things up.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Procurement Specialist, Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com | +1 628-555-0114

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Nadia Khan <nadia.khan@glb-int.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: New vendor onboarding — W-9 and bank letter attached

Rachel — quick note from procurement: because the legal name tied to the EIN doesn't match the submitted W-9, our policy is to keep the PO on hold until we have either

- an updated W-9 that matches the EIN record, or
- a notarized corporate letter that explains the DBA/name variation and confirms signatory authority.

On limited occasions we can issue a conditional PO for up to 25% of the value if accounting approves and the vendor accepts payment terms that include a final reconciling invoice, but that requires a written exception and will slow down processing.

Thanks for the clarity — attaching a screenshot of the IRS EIN lookup as requested. The screenshot is labeled GI_EIN_lookup_screenshot.png.

Notes: our registered legal name is indeed "Global Integrations LLC" (the filings and EIN are under that name). The invoice template used by our billing team mistakenly uses the trade name "Global Integrations Ltd." — we've asked billing to update current invoices and to include the full legal name + DBA line on new invoices going forward.

Attachments: GI_EIN_lookup_screenshot.png

Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept the IRS screenshot + a corrected W-9 to release the PO? If a temporary partial PO is an option, we'd appreciate that to enable the initial project work.

Apologies for the confusion — we want to keep the onboarding moving.

Best,
Nadia Khan
Head of Finance
Global Integrations Ltd.

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Nadia Khan <nadia.khan@glb-int.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 15:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — W-9 and bank letter attached

Hi Nadia — thanks for the screenshot and for explaining the billing/name discrepancy. From a tax-compliance standpoint the screenshot of the IRS EIN confirmation plus the signed W-9 is acceptable as interim evidence, however we need one additional item to close the file:

• Please upload a corrected W-9 that lists the legal name exactly as on the IRS record ("Global Integrations LLC"). If you prefer to keep the trade name on invoices, include the DBA line in box 1 of the W-9 (e.g., "Global Integrations LLC dba Global Integrations Ltd.").

If you can provide the corrected W-9 by COB Monday, 8 Jun 2026, we can move the PO from "on hold" to "pending approval" and target full release the same week. If you need a partial PO, Marcus will need a signed acceptance of the conditional terms; let me know and I'll coordinate with accounting.

Next steps:
- Nadia: upload corrected W-9 to the Drive link (or attach here)
- Redwood: tax will re-validate; procurement will schedule PO release

Reference: Onboarding checklist (internal) — https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cGI_OnboardingChecklist

Thanks,
